title: Runway ops sticky notes rollup — May 2029
content:
Purpose: quick, owner-led inventory of active "sticky" asks that touch runway (next 6 weeks). Not a full capacity plan — minimal columns to unblock cross-team handoffs and short-term escalations. Use this sheet during daily 09:30 stand and update owners inline.

How to use:
- If you own an item, keep the row and mark progress; if it slips >3 business days, note a blocker and escalate in #ops-runway.
- Rows are intentionally terse: we want 1-line context + one clear ask.
- Review owners weekly; rotate items out to backlog when done.

Columns (spreadsheet view):
- id | short-title | owner | scope | concrete-ask | ETA | current-status | blocker | impact-if-missed | notes/links

Sample rows (paste into sheet):
1, "billing-surge-guard", Priya Shah, CDN + API, "add 1ms timeout fallback on billing endpoint", 2029-05-10, "dev-in-progress", "depends on infra-canary config (OPS-3245)", "medium (customer billing delay)", "Slack: #billing-ops; PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789"
2, "dedicated-region-dns", Ethan Cole, infra-dns, "coordinate TTL drop and pre-warm origin", 2029-05-14, "waiting-on-dns-admin", "legal signoff on cert rotation", "high (outage risk)", "JIRA: DNS-1122; runbook link in confluence"
3, "console-telemetry-delta", Maya Liu, console, "short-term metric parity shim for rollout page", 2029-05-09, "merged but monitoring flaky", "observability agent flapping on staging", "low (UX only)", "monitoring graph: grafana://console-rollout"
4, "private-deploy-credentials", Hannah Kim, private-deploy, "confirm KMS rotation window and notify customers", 2029-05-20, "not-started", "awaiting KMS calendar slots", "medium (customer ops)", "Linked: confluence:private-kms-rotation"
5, "embed-cost-smoke", Alex Torres, optimize, "run spot embedding cost smoke test for new quant profile", 2029-05-11, "queued", "quota for test cluster", "medium (cost regression risk)", "ref: OPS-3289; test script: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/tests/emb-smoke.sh"

Quick rollup summary (for stand):
- 5 active sticky items. 2 are blocked (dns, billing fallback).
- Owners assigned for all; 2 require cross-team escalation (dns -> infra+legal, billing -> runtime).
- Immediate ask: Priya to create an escalation thread in #ops-runway for billing by EOD today.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Who is the primary on-call for short-notice DNS changes next week? (Action: Ethan to confirm by 2029-05-08)
- Can we safely lower billing endpoint timeout to 700ms for customers on Dedicated without spike? (Action: runtime team to validate in canary; see OPS-3245)

Meeting cadence and ownership notes:
- Daily 09:30 quick sync (10 minutes) — update progress, escalate blockers.
- Weekly triage (15 minutes) on Fridays for anything clustered for the following week.
- Runbook owners: add a single bullet with a link in the notes column for any item that touches production-change.

Next steps (short):
- Priya: open #ops-runway escalation for billing today.
- Ethan: confirm DNS on-call and attach contact in row 2.
- Maya: monitor merged telemetry change and report stability by 2029-05-12.
- Hannah: schedule KMS window and add customer notification template by 2029-05-15.

Notes to self (informal scratch):
- Keep rows lean; if something needs >3 lines, move to a backlog sheet and link.
- If a row becomes a long-lived project (>3 weeks), convert to a lightweight jira ticket and move out of this sheet.

Revision history:
- 2029-05-03 created by Priya Shah (initial import of sticky notes from whiteboard)
- 2029-05-09 additions from Maya and Ethan after daily sync
- 2029-05-17 minor cleanup and status refresh before review

Contact: Priya Shah (priya@redwood.ai) for questions on ownership or process.
